why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the rewards site Go to the American Fortress Loyalty Program at quests.americanfortress.io , the project's own rewards site.
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet Use the Connect Wallet button on the rewards site and sign in. History of your points and rewards is only shown after you connect.
3 Step 3 : Earn points through community activity The program invites you to earn points by contributing to the growth of the American Fortress community. Points from social activity update daily.
4 Step 4 : Check your points history Return to the rewards site to see your earned points and rewards history. For background on the product behind the program, see the American Fortress homepage .
